management.bio: Ex-Indian Army drill instructor leading 1.6km speed endurance drills, obstacle courses, and physical fitness assessments.

objectives: Integrated Defence & Uniformed Services Career Prep: Prepare 120 rural youth for Army, Police, and paramilitary entrance through structured physical drills and academic coaching.
Women Empowerment & Career Development: Train 75 women in computer fundamentals, MS Office, spoken English, leadership, and financial independence.
Youth Skill Development & Employability: Provide 75 youth with employment-oriented IT skills, Tally/GST, digital marketing, and apprenticeship linkages.
Sports, Fitness & Youth Leadership: Engage 30+ athletes in athletics, Fauji Cup BPL tournaments, physical camps, and leadership building.
Digital Learning & Career Support Cell: Operate a modern digital learning lab, competitive exam book bank, and employer linkage cell in Betul.
Transparent CSR Implementation: Maintain 100% compliance under MCA Schedule VII, 12A/12AB, 80G tax exemption, and CSR-1 registration.
